title: Yellow Smoky Argentinian Beef Wrap
description: A smoky and light Argentinian dish featuring gherkin relish and leaf wrap steam, perfect for a quick fix meal. This low fat friendly recipe is made with tender beef and fresh ingredients.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium high heat.
Season the beef strips with smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Grill the beef strips for 5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Meanwhile, prepare the gherkin relish by stirring it with lime juice.
Lay the collard green leaves flat and place a few slices of grilled beef in the center of each leaf.
Top the beef with a spoonful of gherkin relish.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Serve the wraps hot, with additional gherkin relish on the side if desired.
